name: Fujiwara no Mototoshi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 75); Porter’s note gives the dates as: early 12th century.

poems.title: It is a promise unfulfilled
poems.author: Fujiwara no Mototoshi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 75
poems.text:
It is a promise unfulfilled,
For which I humbly sue;
The dainty little mugwort plant
Relies upon the dew,
And I rely—on you.

poems.title: 75. 契りおきし させもが露を 命にて (Chigiriokishi sasemo ga tsuyu o inochi nite)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Mototoshi
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
契りおきし させもが露を 命にて
あはれ今年の 秋も去ぬめり
